name: Yanai (Japan, 1954–2005)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yanai city emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised pointed device with a disc.
history: Earlier flag of Yanai city in Yamaguchi Prefecture, used from 1954 to 2005.

features.role: Yanai city emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised pointed device with a disc
